name: Rossmann Store Sales
description: Rossmann Store Sales is a demand-forecasting benchmark originating from a 2015 Kaggle competition, in which entrants forecast six weeks of daily sales for 1,115 Rossmann drug stores across Germany. The data combine historical daily sales with covariates such as promotions, school and state holidays, competition distance, and store type. It has become a standard applied case study for retail demand forecasting and feature-driven gradient-boosting pipelines.
typical_sota_score: Top competition entries achieved private-leaderboard RMSPE around 0.10, driven by gradient boosting and entity-embedding neural networks.
reputation: A widely cited Kaggle demand-forecasting case study, frequently used to illustrate feature engineering and gradient-boosting (and entity-embedding) approaches to retail sales prediction.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; a tabular/time-series forecasting dataset. Results depend heavily on feature engineering and handling of promotions, holidays, and store closures. Leaderboard scores can reflect overfitting to the competition validation split.
